signals.label: Lifetime definition

evidence.quote: We may also terminate for convenience, including by discontinuing the Platform, with 30 days' notice.

signals.label: Hidden caps

signals.label: Vendor age & track record

signals.label: Discount size

claims.text: Can save creators from any search into targeted lists

finePrint.summary: Lifetime means as long as Creator Lookup offers the platform, not the buyer's lifetime, limited to deal features at purchase.

quote.text: "lifetime" means for as long as we offer the Platform, not the lifetime of the purchaser, and covers the features and limits stated in the deal at purchase;

finePrint.summary: Even within published limits, use must stay at ordinary creator discovery levels and not degrade the platform for others.

quote.text: Even within the Usage Limits, your use must be consistent with ordinary creator discovery and outreach by your own account.

finePrint.summary: Monthly credits expire at end of billing period unless the plan says otherwise and have no cash value.

quote.text: Unused monthly credits expire at the end of each billing period unless your plan says otherwise.

finePrint.summary: Paid plans are credit-based where one credit equals one creator export with insights and contact info.

quote.text: 1 credit = 1 creator with insights and contact info.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime and marketplace purchases follow the marketplace refund window, then become final with no further refund.

quote.text: Handled by the marketplace under its own refund policy and window.

finePrint.summary: Subscriptions are non-refundable except for a pro-rata refund if core paid features are materially reduced.

quote.text: Exception: if we materially reduce your plan's core features during a paid period, you may request a pro-rata refund of the unused portion

finePrint.summary: Vendor can update terms by posting a new version, with 30 days email notice for material changes.

quote.text: we may update these Terms. We will post the new version and update the Effective Date.

finePrint.summary: Vendor can adjust usage limits over time by updating the limits page for all customers on a plan.

quote.text: We may adjust the Usage Limits from time to time.

finePrint.summary: Subscription prices can be changed with 30 days notice, applying from the next renewal.

quote.text: We may change subscription prices with at least 30 days' notice.

finePrint.summary: A lifetime license can be terminated for material breach with no refund.

quote.text: we may terminate a lifetime license for a material breach of these Terms, without refund.

finePrint.summary: Vendor can terminate for convenience including discontinuing the platform on 30 days notice with refund of unused fees.

quote.text: We may also terminate for convenience, including by discontinuing the Platform, with 30 days' notice.

finePrint.summary: If usage limits are violated, vendor can immediately throttle or suspend access or terminate the account without prior notice.

quote.text: we may immediately and without prior notice throttle or rate limit your access, suspend API or MCP access, revoke API keys, or suspend or terminate your account.

finePrint.summary: Support is email, in-app chat on paid plans, and help center in English weekdays 9am-6pm Pacific.

quote.text: Support is available by email at support@creatorlookup.com, through in-app chat on paid plans, and through our help center, in English, Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM Pacific Time.

finePrint.summary: Response time targets are 4 hours for critical, 24 hours for high-priority, and 48 hours for general inquiries.

quote.text: We aim to respond to critical issues (Platform down) within 4 hours, to high-priority issues (a core feature broken) within 24 hours, and to general inquiries within 48 hours.

finePrint.summary: Beta features have no support commitment or uptime target and can change or be removed anytime.

quote.text: Beta or experimental features are provided "as is," may change or be removed at any time, and are not covered by any support commitment or uptime target.

finePrint.summary: Regular offer starts with a monthly plan or one-time credit packs for creator exports.

quote.text: Start with a monthly plan, or buy credits one-time.

finePrint.summary: One-time credit packs have no subscription and per-credit price drops as pack size scales.

quote.text: No subscription. Drag to size your pack — per-credit price drops as you scale. Credits never expire.

finePrint.summary: 99.5% uptime is a target only, not a guarantee, with no credits unless outage exceeds 10 consecutive days.

quote.text: We target 99.5% monthly uptime, excluding scheduled maintenance.

trials.claim: Deal includes all future Basic, Pro, Plus plan updates
trials.claimQuote: All future Basic Plan (Tier 1), Pro (Tier 2), Plus (Tier 3) plan updates
trials.reasoning: The binding terms limit lifetime coverage to the features and limits stated at purchase and say later features may be offered only on other plans or as paid add-ons, directly conflicting with all future plan updates being included.

exhibits.quote: "lifetime" means for as long as we offer the Platform, not the lifetime of the purchaser, and covers the features and limits stated in the deal at purchase;
exhibits.argument: Lifetime coverage is limited to features and limits stated at purchase, not all future plan updates.

exhibits.quote: except where a marketplace deal requires otherwise, features released later may be offered only on other plans or as paid add-ons;
exhibits.argument: Future features may be excluded from the deal and sold separately on other plans or add-ons.

trials.claim: Future AI models may cost extra via discounted rate or add-on
trials.claimQuote: Access to all future AI models may be provided at a discounted rate OR Access to future AI models may require an add on
trials.reasoning: The terms state features released later may be offered only on other plans or as paid add-ons, directly supporting that future AI models may require an extra add-on charge.

exhibits.quote: except where a marketplace deal requires otherwise, features released later may be offered only on other plans or as paid add-ons;
exhibits.argument: The quote states future features may require other plans or paid add-ons.

trials.claim: Access to an AI-powered database of 400M+ creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube
trials.claimQuote: Search an AI-powered influencer database of 400M+ creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube
trials.reasoning: The defense only shows the 400M+ database is advertised, not that buyers actually access 400M+ creators, and one review shows search capacity exhausted with an absurd retry time.

exhibits.quote: metrics may differ from native platform analytics, contact details can go out of date, and audience demographics and pricing are statistical estimates.
exhibits.argument: Database contents are estimates that can be inaccurate and out of date, not guaranteed verified access.

exhibits.quote: Search capacity temporarily exhausted. Retry in 108585212 seconds
exhibits.argument: Search access can be exhausted and blocked for an absurd retry period, undermining promised access.

exhibits.quote: Stop scrolling through endless profiles. Just describe who you need: 'fitness micro-influencers in LA with high engagement', and our AI finds them instantly across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and more.
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes AI finding creators instantly across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube.

exhibits.quote: With access to a database advertised at 400 million creators across Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok, this platform has some serious potential.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms database is advertised at 400 million creators across the three platforms.

trials.claim: Can filter creators by niche, audience, engagement, reach, recent posts and verified contacts in one view
trials.claimQuote: Filter creators by niche, audience, and engagement, then vet reach, recent posts, and verified contacts in one view
trials.reasoning: Buyers confirm creator search, audience insights and contact information are together and that searches can be narrowed by niche and engagement; the prosecution exhibits show data may need review but do not negate that filtering view.

exhibits.quote: My initial searches weren't quite what I expected, but a walkthrough with Matteo helped clarify the filters.
exhibits.argument: Filters did not work as expected without human help, undermining one-view filtering claim.

exhibits.quote: contact details can go out of date, and audience demographics and pricing are statistical estimates.
exhibits.argument: Verified contacts and audience data are admitted to be out-of-date estimates, not reliable in one view.

exhibits.quote: What I like about CreatorLookup is how it brings creator search, audience insights, and contact information all together.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms search, audience insights and contact info are together in one view.

exhibits.quote: The ability to narrow searches by niche, location, and engagement is particularly useful.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms filtering by niche and engagement works.

trials.claim: Plain-English request surfaces matching creators from 400M+ profiles
trials.claimQuote: Type a request like "tech reviewers in the US" to surface matching creators from 400M+ profiles on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube
trials.reasoning: The vendor and a buyer both confirm describing the creator you need in plain English lets the AI find matching creators across the platforms; preferring manual filters or needing to review AI output does not contradict that capability.

exhibits.quote: The AI was cool, but I actually preferred playing with the manual filters for such a specific niche!
exhibits.argument: Plain-English AI search was less effective than manual filters for a specific niche request.

exhibits.quote: You are responsible for reviewing AI output before relying on it or sending it, including any outreach message sent under your name.
exhibits.argument: AI matching output must be reviewed before reliance because it can be wrong or incomplete.

exhibits.quote: Stop scrolling through endless profiles. Just describe who you need: 'fitness micro-influencers in LA with high engagement', and our AI finds them instantly across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and more.
exhibits.argument: Vendor says describing who you need lets AI find matching creators.

exhibits.quote: I can simply describe the type of creator I'm looking for in plain English, and the AI goes to work.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms plain-English description surfaces matching creators via AI.
